title: Concept: LDAP filter built by concatenation (php) — review required
description: In php, ldap_search($c, $b, "(uid=$u)") mixes filter syntax with values. LDAP metacharacters (*, (, ), \) in input alter which entries match. The remedy is value escaping via ldap_escape for filter values.
applicability: php codebases querying directories with assembled filters; single-line lexical scope.
risk: Authentication bypass and directory disclosure; HIGH severity for login paths.
